findings.text: The arm row says "the three failures base has that head does not are this node's own test cases", but the two logs differ by five ids: three node tests plus tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py::test_claim_move_aside_is_not_a_staged_write and ::test_every_staged_write_reaches_the_owner, so two unrelated base failures are silently attributed to the node.

`assert _record_path(repo).is_file()` is satisfied by _write_frame, which pre-creates that exact path before _close runs, so the assertion holds whether or not the healthy composition wrote anything; the case's real evidence is the absent warning and the absent failure record.

The head gate log's revision header reads `e7e33584ac... (head, plus uncommitted node work)`, naming the base revision rather than head 67b204b8e9 the evidence fragment cites; the head commit is proven only by arm-head.log's header, so the done-when's requirement that the head gate log carry its revision is not strictly met.
